title: The manifest

posts.caption:
Every DAUR box carries a Manifest Card.
One side says why we exist. The other lists your terms in plain words: 5 day size exchange, 30 days on defects, 48 hours to report a wrong or damaged item. At least 5% of our profit goes to verified cases in need.
Design render. Real photos when the first kits are made.
